story.title: Story 2: Event Capture and Turn Derivation

result.reviewScopeSummary: Initial verification of Story 2 against AC-2.1 through AC-2.8, TC-2.1 through TC-2.9, current capture source/tests, artifacts, LHC duplicate-key behavior, and configured gates.

newFindings.title: Fresh attach can skip a new same-content id-less message
newFindings.evidence: AC-2.1 requires every finalized PI message to land exactly once, and AC-2.6 requires dedup to skip re-delivery without skipping genuinely new events. MessageEndEvent.entryId and position are optional in packages/pi-lhc/src/pi/types.ts:36-39. On every session_start, packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:309-314 initializes captureSession.sourceSeq to 0, and packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:354-359 uses sourceSeq only when no position exists. The message_end path uses that fallback when entryId is absent at packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts:390-399. A focused check showed a first id-less/no-position user prompt and a fresh resumed connector's new same-content id-less/no-position prompt both map to the same key: `pi:thread-1:fp:message_end:sourceSeq:0:0:user:user_prompt:54ca60525216f9233258b2f6`. LHC skips duplicate keys at packages/lhc/src/domains/intake-stream/internal/pipeline.ts:210-216, so the new finalized event can be silently skipped. Existing reattach tests cover different-content resume at packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/reattach-idempotency.test.ts:49-69 and same-content reload re-delivery at lines 286-306, but not a new same-content id-less event after fresh attach.

verified: AC-2.1 / TC-2.1: ordered user/assistant/toolResult capture and assistant thinking -> text -> tool_call fan-out are covered through the real hook -> converter -> LHC intake path in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/converter.test.ts:43-87.
AC-2.2 / TC-2.2: the worked example records one LHC turn_end at agent_end and PI per-step turn_end hooks produce none in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/turn-derivation.test.ts:39-83.
AC-2.2 / TC-2.3: two runs with repeated turnIndex 0 order by converter source-event order in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/turn-derivation.test.ts:86-118.
AC-2.3 / TC-2.4: out-of-order parallel tool results correlate by toolCallId in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/parallel-and-errors.test.ts:39-77.
AC-2.4 / TC-2.5: tool_result isError and error content are captured without drop in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/parallel-and-errors.test.ts:80-105.
AC-2.5 / TC-2.6: graceful interrupt partial content, aborted disposition runtime_note, and complete-but-aborted turn close are covered in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/abort.test.ts:29-65.

AC-2.6 / TC-2.7: same-key re-delivery skips are covered for entryId/source-position-backed cases in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/parallel-and-errors.test.ts:145-191 and packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/reattach-idempotency.test.ts:88-136, 170-260.

AC-2.7 / TC-2.8: malformed writable-thread input records a durable capture gap surfaced in health, unavailable store records health signal with no thrown hook exception, and unmappable hook input records a gap in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/converter.test.ts:171-306.
AC-2.8 / TC-2.9: model_select and thinking_level_select produce ordered runtime_note events with previous/new values in packages/pi-lhc/test/capture/converter.test.ts:90-152.
unverified: AC-2.1 / AC-2.6 / TC-2.7: a fresh resumed/reloaded connector receiving a new same-content message_end without entryId or position is not safe; current key construction collides with the prior thread's sourceSeq:0 event and focused evidence fails.

gatesRun.command: pnpm --filter pi-lhc exec tsx -e '<same-content no-entry/no-position fresh-attach key collision check>'

productionPathFindings: packages/pi-lhc/src/index.ts resets captureSession.sourceSeq to 0 for every attach and uses it in fallback idempotency keys when PI supplies neither entryId nor position; because LHC skips duplicate idempotency keys, a new same-content id-less message after resume/reload can be skipped as a duplicate.
additionalObservations: Configured story and epic gates pass: 14 test files / 71 tests passed in each run.
No material fake adapter, mock path, shim, or placeholder was found in the Story 2 capture path.
